name: Procedural Volume Rendering with Noise Perturbation
aliases: Volume Perturbation via Texture Coordinate Displacement
definition: Enhances a coarse macrostructure volume at render time by perturbing texture coordinates and optical properties using a small tiling noise volume, creating wispy, cloud-like filaments suitable for real-time clouds, smoke, and fire.
summary: Procedural Volume Rendering with Noise Perturbation enhances coarse volumetric data by warping sampling coordinates or modulating optical properties with procedural noise, avoiding the cost of higher resolution.
